paper.title: DETR R50, 500-epoch COCO schedule (Section 4, Appendix A.4)

note: 500 epochs with LR drop at 400 (batch 64 on 16 V100s, ~1848 iters/epoch); the 300-epoch schedule drops at 200. Requires a COCO loader with scale augmentation (shortest side 480-800, max 1333) and random crops, plus an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 (torchvision weights) — not wired up here; the train loop uses synthetic rectangles. COCO AP should be computed with pycocotools.
